objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Get command execution on the image resizer and read /ctf/flag.
hints: The chosen size ends up inside a shell command line built by the application.
Read about OS command injection and shell command separators in the OWASP testing guide.

steps.title: Identify the tool
steps.prompt: Which image tool does the server call to resize the picture?

steps.title: Find the input
steps.prompt: Which form field reaches the shell command? (field name)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: What class of vulnerability is this?
